---
title: "hypoad_validation_analysis"
output: html_document
date: "2026-08-04"
---

```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(BPCells)
library(khroma)
library(harmony)

hypoad_human = readRDS("./HypoAD.RDS")


#convert all non-doublet cells > 1000 UMIs, < 100,000, < 5% mito, and non-doublet to bpcells 
#filter for only primary data
keep_metadata = hypoad_human@meta.data %>% filter(total_counts > 2000 & total_counts < 1e5 & pct_counts_mt < 5 & scDblFinder_class == 1 & is_primary_data)
counts_mat = hypoad_human@assays$RNA@counts[,keep_metadata %>% rownames]

bpcells_mat_hypoad_counts = counts_mat %>% as("IterableMatrix")

bpcells_mat_hypoad_counts = bpcells_mat_hypoad_counts %>% write_matrix_dir("./hypoad_counts_bpcells_mat",overwrite = T)


saveRDS(keep_metadata,"cell_metadata_hypoad_post_qc.rds")


donor_metadata = distinct(keep_metadata %>% select(donor_id, age, sex_f, Braak, condition))

saveRDS(donor_metadata, "donor_metadata_hypoad_post_qc.rds")



```
